extracted.name: Pumpkin Sugar Cookies
extracted.description: Pumpkin sugar cookies are a rolled sugar cookie recipe that tastes like pumpkin. They're a festive addition to Thanksgiving or Christmas dessert platters.
instruction_lines: Beat sugar and butter together in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth and creamy; beat in egg until smooth. Beat in pumpkin purée, vanilla extract, cinnamon, salt, and baking powder. Stir in flour just until combined. Refrigerate dough for 2 hours to overnight.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Roll dough on a floured work surface. Cut into shapes using cookie cutters; arrange on a baking sheet.
Bake in the preheated oven until edges are lightly browned, 6 to 8 minutes.
